docxPassages.text: The beliefs recorded in this appendix are mortal theology, not objective cosmic history. Priests, scholars, and cults across Aethel have spent millennia reasoning about forces they cannot fully perceive. What follows is what the faithful believe: a creation myth, a pantheon of worshiped faces, and a diagram of the planes — sincerely held, widely taught, and useful for understanding how ordinary people in Aethel think about the divine. Your character may treat this as literal truth. Deeper mysteries of the Spiral and the Crucible may surface only through play; even then, the wider world does not rewrite its temples overnight. Scholars may also speak of the First Choir — seven named virtues (Korvelan, Vaerilune, Delvaran, Shaelara, Xalarex, Thalirion, and Virellian) — as part of the wider Spiral story. That knowledge is not secret, but it is not tavern talk either.

These courts are in constant flux, with territories expanding and contracting based on the changing seasons, the waxing and waning of emotions, and the outcomes of elaborate games and contests. Mortals who become entangled in Fey politics often find themselves bound by rules they don't understand and agreements they don't remember making.

The Veiled Expanse is dominated by the Shadow Conclave, a loose alliance of powerful entities who have claimed dominion over different aspects of shadow, death, and darkness. Unlike the Fey Courts or Elemental Courts, the Shadow Conclave operates more like a council of equals, each member respecting the others' territories while pursuing their own agendas.
The Raven Regent - Mistress of death and fate
The Nightlord - Master of darkness and fear
The Grief Sovereign - Ruler of sorrow and loss
The Forgotten King - Keeper of abandoned memories

The Shadow Conclave rarely acts in unison, but when faced with threats to the Veiled Expanse itself, they can combine their considerable powers to devastating effect. Their agents often work in the Material Plane, collecting souls, spreading darkness, or maintaining the balance between life and death.
Gate opening, mass protection, camp relocation
Weather, planar travel, resurrection, sovereign ward
Matrical theorem, Old One location, permanent dungeon change

Ordinary spell research can be completed with Arcana and a laboratory. Matrix research cannot. The primary researcher must personally possess high ranks in multiple disciplines—Arcana, History, Religion, Nature, and Engineering—and must cross-reference rare drops, libraries, mechanisms, and seasonal changes. Archive knowledge may be inherited; cognitive continuity usually cannot.
Defensive patterns separate, deny, bind, or return. Specialists are strongest when they know exactly what they are protecting against.
Conjuration changes location, presence, and availability. It is the school most likely to create extraction shortcuts—and catastrophic breaches.
Chapter 19 — Craft and Research as Machine-Feed

Crafting and research are not side activities bolted onto combat — they are how an Expedition converts what it survives into what it can do next, and (per Chapter 8) they are one more way the machine keeps mortals coming back.

Craft. Recipes draw components from bestiary loot tiers, so a Resource team's hunting choices should visibly feed later crafting. Where a published recipe's component list is incomplete, assign a finite and reasonable salvage requirement; do not treat missing text as permission for free or unlimited crafting.

Research. Research teams translate, identify, and map. Spire lore, Gate-rune inscriptions, and Surveyor seals all function as a kind of expedition currency — spend them like treasure, not like flavor text. Between-session research (Chapter 24) is the right tool for anything that would otherwise burn table time on repeated checks with no dramatic content.

The machine-feed framing. Every crafted weapon carried back into the depths, every translated Gate-rune that opens a seal faster next time, and every research chain that identifies a dungeon-touched item well enough to sell it are all, in the end, more resonance flowing through the Heartcell (Chapter 8). You never need to say this to your players — but keeping it in your head as you design craft and research content will naturally make those systems feel connected to the setting's deeper logic instead of feeling like a detached minigame.

A Gate may include checks, but no single check should decide whether an entire campaign continues. Provide multiple ways to satisfy the requirement, allow failures to increase cost or change the confrontation, and make research reduce uncertainty. A party that reaches the Gate without the intended key should be able to retreat, bargain, improvise at a severe price, or discover a secondary path.

Place one clue in the environment, one in an NPC or rival relationship, one in a recoverable record, and one in the behavior of the tier’s hazards. The Expedition should be able to assemble the truth from different team contributions. This is where the twelve-seat structure earns its place: Combat may hold the approach, Reconnaissance finds the seam, Research reads the sequence, Resource prepares the material, and Support keeps the ritual intact.
Opening a Gate Changes the Tier

value.name: Soul Mark

operational.targets: One creature you perceive within 30 feet and line of effect that is not currently Dead or destroyed. An active Undead or Construct qualifies if its actual rules classify it as a creature; those tags alone do not make it ineligible. Objects and corpses are not eligible merely because they once were creatures.
operational.duration: 1 minute, no concentration. If applied in initiative, ends at the caster's tenth future regular-start marker; outside initiative, ends 60 elapsed seconds after application. Preserve its virtual phase or absolute deadline through initiative changes, absence and death; an already-passed start does not count. Ends earlier if the marked creature dies, is destroyed, or its summoned existence ends. Mere travel out of range or to another plane does not end the mark.
operational.resolution: No save. Apply one invisible, nonphysical mark to the selected creature. While that marked creature is on your plane and within 1 mile (5,280 feet), you continuously sense its direction from your current position, including meaningful vertical bearing.
operational.effect: The direction is a bearing, not its distance, exact coordinates, room, route, appearance, surroundings or condition. Ordinary cover and walls after application do not block the sense. A specific divination/masking protection applies to its actual scope; a blocked read supplies no bearing. Beyond 1 mile or on another plane also gives no bearing, without distinguishing why. Shapechange, disguise and appearance changes retain the same creature identity and do not detach or transfer the mark. Death, destruction or the ending of the marked summon’s existence ends this application. It does not resume on revival, reconstruction or resummoning and does not track a corpse, detached soul or replacement body. A shapechange that retains the same continuing creature identity does not by itself count as death, destruction or an ended summoned existence.
operational.scaling: None. No automatic increase in targets, range, duration or information.
operational.limitations: One active Soul Mark per caster across classes; successful recasting replaces it. Other casters may independently mark the same creature with their own endpoints. Protection from Scrying blocks the new directional information while applicable, not automatically the noninformational existence of this mark; an otherwise surviving mark can again report direction when protection ends. Expiry/death never leaves a removable item or corpse beacon. No condition, allegiance, identity-change announcement, precise location, passage through a wall or ownership of the target is granted. One successful application owns its endpoint; stale cleanup cannot remove its replacement. A failed or countered cast creates no replacement and refunds no committed casting cost or strain. Actual class access and repertoire, audible V/free-hand S components, casting sequence, Refrain/Dissonance, class hooks and interruption follow SPELL_INTEGRATION_RULES.md. Base RP is 0 but repeated cantrips still follow their actual strain rules. No automatic upcast or unstated scaling. Source-specific protections apply only to their actual scope. Protection from Scrying prevents new Divination/Scrying information about its protected subject, including beneficial inspection, but grants no blanket immunity to damage, buffs or other noninformational mechanics merely because of their school; it does not erase already-known facts or ordinary records.
operational.designNotes: PRESERVED: Action/30feet/V,S,1minute tag and direction within1mile. NEW: creature-versus-corpse and death/destruction/summon-end boundary; no Undead/Construct exclusion based only on type, same-plane bearing, nonphysical marker, ordinary-wall continuation, independent caster records and explicit no-information result. No concentration or saving throw is added.

value.procedure:
KEEP exactly one illusionary copy of the caster lasting3rounds. NEW place one visual/audible image matching the caster's actual visible body/equipment at a perceived legal open position within60feet/line of effect. It is a nonphysical image in the caster's current size/appearance snapshot,not a creature/object withHP. The copied appearance does not update when the caster later transforms or changes clothes;creating a replacement pays a new cast. It produces ordinary conversational speech/simple body sounds in the caster's known voice/languages,not light,heat,smell,force,real music powers or a new sensory feed. NEW no concentration;ends at the caster's third future regular START or18elapsed seconds outside initiative,preserving the original marker/deadline through extra turns and absence.

Once on each actual ordinary caster turn,an available Bonus Action can move the image up to30feet through a declared continuous path within60feet/caster line of effect and direct one brief mundane performance or sentence. It cannot pass through walls,closed doors or another solid barrier;it may visually imitate an actual apparent locomotion the snapshot body has,but that creates no cargo/support/anatomy permission. It can overlap real creatures because it lacks substance,without blocking them. The Bonus Action uses the real action wallet;the image gets no independent turn or attack. With no command it holds its last position/pose and continues only a previously declared simple idle appearance,not independent plans,choices or secret observations. Losing command range leaves it stationary until expiry,not invisibly following the caster.

NEW decoy function:while this image is within5feet of its actual caster and both are legal visible candidate positions for an incoming direct attack roll,a sight-dependent attacker who has not identified this image as false cannot visually distinguish them during the spell's brief identical-image shimmer. Select uniformly among the caster and this live indistinguishable image before rolling. If actual Mirror Image duplicates also legally qualify,use one combined uniform selection among the caster and all eligible live visual duplicates,not serial independent miss chances. No image outside the attack's real reach/range/line of effect joins that selection. A source explicitly ignoring visual illusions,actual True Seeing,or that attacker's genuine recognition removes the corresponding false candidate.

If the true caster is selected,resolve that one attack normally. If Arcane Clone is selected,roll against the caster's current realAC;hit ends this clone,miss leaves it. No numericHP damage,critical body injury,on-hit resource,corpse or actual creature-target rider is generated. The attack's ordinary ammunition/action costs stay spent. At a separate position outside the decoy pairing,the image can be deliberately mistaken for an apparent creature and attacked using this same image-hit procedure,but it never automatically intercepts an attack on the caster. Caster/allies cannot intentionally farm hits/procs from their known false image. Area/save effects ignore it;it grants no cover,flanking or reaction interception. Choosing among overlapping valid visual duplicates occurs only once for the original attack lineage.

An observer may spend an Action on INT(Investigation)against the original spellDC to recognize the image;real direct physical passage/touch showing no substance establishes recognition without a roll for that observer. Identification leaves its appearance for others but removes its own mechanical deception against that observer. True Seeing uses its actual source scope. A known false image cannot block that observer's sight,though unrelated actual terrain still can. An imitated casting gesture is no real spell commitment and creates no Counterspell trigger,RP payment,spell copy or new attack. A genuine readied response to an actually observed movement/sound can still use its real trigger rules;the image does not force anyone to respond.

One Arcane Clone per caster;successful new creation replaces the old,without returning resources or resetting an attack already begun. Suppression hides the image and removes its decoy candidacy while the original deadline continues;missed commands do not queue,and return supplies no new duplicate or forgotten-disbelief reset. Actual dispel,expiry,a qualifying hit or caster death ends it. This is neither a biological clone,extra class sheet,stored consciousness,death replacement nor soul transfer.
workedCases: TU6-09-A: The caster has three valid Mirror Image duplicates and one adjacent Arcane Clone. For a sight-dependent attacker with valid geometry,the proposed combined selection has five equal candidates:the caster and four images,not a50%test followed by another independent test. Selecting Arcane Clone and hitting the caster's currentAC ends only that image and produces no creature-hit resource.

TU6-09-B: The clone is30feet away and repeats a declared sentence. It supplies no view of who listens,and does not automatically intercept an attack on the caster. An observer walks through it and knows it is false without Investigation. Suppression followed by resumption cannot erase that knowledge,refresh its eighteen-second outside deadline or create real spellcasting from its gestures.
value.newChoices: NEW independent audiovisual three-round decoy,BA movement,combined single visual-duplicate selection and observer-specific disbelief without body/resources/remote senses.
value.originalQuestion: Preserve ONE ILLUSIONARY COPY OF THE CASTER for3ROUNDS,Core Action/60ft/3rounds. Define initial placement,appearance,sensory channels,movement/control cost and a finite gameplay function,including whether it decoys attacks or merely provides an image. Compare reviewed Mirror Image and Silent Image without silently equating them. State targetability,disbelief,True Seeing,physical interaction and exact loss/end conditions; a perceived caster copy is not another character with RP,Actions,spells,body,loot or memories. Fix round deadlines across initiative changes,suppression and creator transformation. No actual biological clone,death replacement or soul transfer is printed.

findings.finding: The Player appendix explicitly frames its theology/plane diagram as mortal belief (P9977). Its Shadow Conclave claims death/fate/darkness/memory domains and agents collecting souls (P10355–10363). These are not objective proof of a universal afterlife jurisdiction or identity with the original Choir/Argent Gate.

Core P1302 already requires the Matrix primary researcher personally to possess high ranks in Arcana, History, Religion, Nature and Engineering, cross-referencing rare drops, libraries, mechanisms and seasonal changes. Archive knowledge may be inherited; cognitive continuity usually cannot. The text supplies no numeric definition of high ranks or complete research progression. Ordinary spell research is Arcana plus laboratory. Do not replace this with one generic roll or silently decide what the owner meant by Research skill.

The ritual scale table includes Grand resurrection and Seasonal Matrical theorem examples; table scale is not a complete operational permission or Hunt intervention. Director P896 supplies translation/identification/mapping roles; P1435/1437 recommends distributed Gate clues and avoiding single-roll campaign gates. These can inform design, not prove the Equation has four fragments or a fixed solution.

Soul Mark is reviewed and tracks a continuing nondead creature with its actual endpoint/same-plane bearing rules. It ends on death/destruction and does not track a detached soul, corpse or later replacement body. The name does not authorize an afterlife beacon.

Erase Soul is pending and its original effect is three-round identity confusion/inability to act with WIS early negation, not permanent metaphysical annihilation. Soul Mirror is pending one-spell reflection. Soul Reflection is pending a three-round self-combat version. Their names cannot settle cessation metaphysics.

Clone has only a source question, no completed procedure or joint review. Its biological death-insurance description makes it a future Hunt interface, not an already available escape. Arcane Clone instead preserves an illusionary caster copy for three rounds; the full TU6-09 draft is unadopted and explicitly denies biological clone, death replacement or soul transfer.

Ordinary Soul Cage remains a literal post-push receipt without an adopted procedure. Its Enchantment/ Necromancy variants differ between a dying creature and dying humanoid. A similarly named shield in another source does not approve this ordinary spell. Soulburn Pact is pending HP/RP exchange with preserved3versus5RP source conflict; it is not a soul-contract or divine intervention grant.

coverage.notClaimed: The name-based discovery list is not semantic review of its other matches. No full book, whole catalog, whole research system or universal afterlife claim.
